cli.about: AIC Agent — offline account elevation and password rotation
cli.long_about:
AIC Agent (binary: pim-offline-agent)

DESCRIPTION:
    The AIC Agent provides secure, offline account elevation and
    automated password rotation with web service integration. Designed for
    enterprise environments requiring FIPS-compliant cryptography and
    comprehensive audit trails.

CORE FEATURES:
    - Time-limited elevation codes for temporary privilege escalation
    - Automatic password rotation with configurable policies
    - Comprehensive diagnostics and health monitoring
    - Full audit trail with JSON export capabilities
    - Prometheus metrics for operational visibility
    - Structured logging with daily rotation

USAGE:
    Interactive console (no arguments):
        pim-offline-agent
        → tip: Try 'pim-offline-agent --help' (exit 2)

    Run as daemon (explicit, or non-TTY / systemd bare start):
        pim-offline-agent daemon

    Generate elevation code:
        pim-offline-agent elevate --show-code

    Run diagnostics:
        pim-offline-agent diagnose

    Configure interactively:
        pim-offline-agent wizard

    For more help on a specific command:
        pim-offline-agent <command> --help

DOCUMENTATION:
    Full documentation: README.md
    Installation guide:  INSTALLATION_GUIDE.md
    Monitoring setup:    MONITORING.md
    Shell completions:   SHELL_COMPLETIONS_GUIDE.md
